name: Thank You Page
description: Confirmation page after a booking or enquiry: a check that springs in, a reference number, what happens next in three steps, and a call button.
usage: Give <ThankYouPage /> its own page (for example /thank-you) and send people there after the booking or contact form succeeds. Rewrite the three steps to match what really happens next, and pass a real reference number if your form provides one.
